data.explanation: This is a private invoice (Privatrechnung) from an occupational therapy practice for your daughter's treatment, since it was billed as a private service rather than through statutory health insurance. You should pay the total of €430.00 to the IBAN shown, using the invoice number as reference, by the deadline shown by the app (21 days after the invoice date). Keep the invoice, as such medical expenses can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) on your tax return — a tax advisor can confirm eligibility. If you believe the amount is incorrect, contact the practice directly.
